instruction: Save the background image from the second slide of the presentation to the Desktop as 'slide2_bg.png'.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to slide 2, selected the background image, increased brightness to 50% using the Properties panel, saved the image as background.png to Desktop via right-click > Save. However, the evaluator expected GIMP-level brightness enhancement, not LibreOffice display property change. Score was -0.2 (task error).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate between slides, select images, modify image properties (brightness/contrast) via Properties panel, right-click and save images, navigate file system dialogs, type text values in fields
metadata.failure_analysis: Original task required multi-app workflow (Impress -> GIMP -> save). Model tried to do everything within LibreOffice Impress. The model successfully demonstrated the image export workflow (right-click > Save > navigate to Desktop > type filename > Save).
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed the original task to just the image export part, removing the brightness enhancement requirement. The model demonstrated the full save-image-to-Desktop workflow successfully in the trajectory, so this task isolates that proven capability.
metadata.explanation: Getter retrieves the file at /home/user/Desktop/slide2_bg.png from VM and returns existence status, file size, and first 8 bytes. Metric checks: file exists (0.5), valid PNG magic bytes (0.3), reasonable file size >1KB (0.2).

scoring_breakdown.valid_png: 0.3 - File has valid PNG magic bytes

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the file at /home/user/Desktop/slide2_bg.png using env.controller.get_file() and returns existence, size, and first 8 bytes hex - appropriate for file validation.
Metric correctly checks PNG magic bytes (89504e47), file existence, and minimum size (>1KB) with reasonable partial credit scoring (0.5 + 0.3 + 0.2).
File path in getter matches the instruction's required filename and location (Desktop/slide2_bg.png).

No content verification: the evaluator cannot confirm the saved image is actually the background from slide 2. Any valid PNG saved at that path would pass. This is a common limitation for file-based tasks but reduces confidence.
Metric ignores the expected parameter entirely - all thresholds are hardcoded rather than read from the rules dict. Functionally correct since hardcoded values match the rules, but poor practice.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding image dimension or content-hash verification to confirm the saved file is actually a slide background image (e.g., check dimensions match presentation slide dimensions).
Metric should read thresholds from the expected parameter (min_size, expected_format) rather than hardcoding them, to make the function reusable and consistent with the evaluator config.
